title: Mazda RX8 Custom Headlights WIRED UP with XK Chrome | Throtl | FlyRyde
description:
Mazda RX8 Custom Headlights are all wired up at Throtl. 

Big shout out to XK Glow for supplying the bluetooth controller/app to make playing with the Demon Eyes both easy to do, and super fun! Evan worked on the VR4 headlight project while I got the RGB wire harness dialed specific for the RX8. 

Can't wait till Throtl has the car done and ready for a lucky winner!!!
